name: Ekko
title: the Boy Who Shattered Time

Q.name: Timewinder
Q.description: Ekko throws a device dealing 80/95/110/125/140 + 0.3×AP magic damage. On hitting a champion or reaching the end of its range, it expands into a field that Slows enemies inside by 40/45/50/55.0/60%. After it expands, Ekko recalls it, dealing 40/65/90/115/140 + 0.7×AP magic damage.
Q.summary: Ekko throws a temporal grenade that expands into a time-distortion field upon hitting an enemy champion, slowing and damaging anyone caught inside. After a delay, the grenade rewinds back to Ekko, dealing damage on its return.

W.name: Parallel Convergence
W.description: Passive: Ekko's Attacks against enemies below 30% Health deal (3 + 0.03×AP) × 0.01 missing Health magic damage. Active: Ekko launches a chronosphere lasting 1.5 seconds after a delay that Slows enemies inside by 40%. If Ekko enters the sphere, he detonates it, Stunning for 2.25 seconds and gaining 100/120/140/160/180 + 1.5×AP Shield.
W.summary: Ekko's basic attacks deal bonus magic damage to low health enemies. He can cast Parallel Convergence to split the timeline, creating an anomaly after a few seconds that slows enemies caught inside. If Ekko enters the anomaly, he gains shielding and stuns enemies by suspending them in time.

E.name: Phase Dive
E.description: Ekko dashes and empowers his next Attack to have bonus range, teleport him to his target, and deal an additional 50/75/100/125/150 + 0.4×AP magic damage.
E.summary: Ekko rolls evasively while charging up his Z-Drive. His next attack deals bonus damage and warps reality, teleporting him to his target.

R.name: Chronobreak
R.description: Ekko turns back time, entering Stasis while teleporting to where he was 4 seconds ago and dealing 200/350/500 + 1.75×AP magic damage to nearby enemies. In addition, Ekko restores 100/150/200 + 0.6×AP Health, increased by 3% for each 1% Health he lost in last 4 seconds.
R.summary: Ekko shatters his timeline, becoming untargetable and rewinding to a more favorable point in time. He returns to whenever he was a few seconds ago, and heals for a percentage of the damage received in that duration. Enemies near his arrival zone take massive damage.

Passive.name: Z-Drive Resonance
Passive.description: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.
Passive.summary: Every third attack or damaging spell on the same target deals bonus magic damage, and grants Ekko a burst of speed if the target is a champion.

source: Community Dragon latest (live patch) game files + client data

profile.identity: Mobile AP assassin/skirmisher who procs his three-hit passive, uses W to stun, and rewinds with R to escape or burst.
strengths: R is a near-guaranteed escape and heal
weaknesses: Relies on Q landing for trades
profile.curveNote: Wants E to apply passive reliably.

W.notes: Delayed zone; stuns if Ekko enters it

E.notes: Dash, then next attack blinks to target (dodgeable as an attack)

R.notes: Rewinds to a few seconds ago; damages around arrival

Passive.notes: Third hit procs (check slow on proc)

profile.windowAgainst: R down = no escape; punish when he's used E.
checks: E attack part dodgeable by Jax E
